summary: Backend regression + feature validation for Phase 3 extension (feed reactions). 13/13 pytest cases pass against the public preview URL, covering GET /api/feed/reaction-kinds catalog, POST/DELETE /api/feed/{event_id}/reactions/{kind} shape+idempotency, unknown-kind 400, missing-event returns ok:true w/ empty counts, /api/feed hydration includes reactions:{counts,mine}, two-user isolation of 'mine' arrays, and 401/403 on unauthenticated calls. Fixed a contract violation in services/social.py add_reaction() which used to always return True (making the 2nd POST report created:true) — now inspects update_one.upserted_id and returns True only on real insert. Frontend smoke test on 390px viewport confirmed the login screen renders without errors and the app title/hero image display cleanly. Deeper mobile UI testing (feed reactions bar, instructor Events sub-tab, home 'Beginners welcome' regression at 320/390) was NOT performed in this iteration due to context budget — recommend main agent self-test since all logic-level backend contracts are green.

minor.issue: add_reaction always returned True on upsert (contract said created:false on 2nd POST). Fixed by inspecting result.upserted_id in services/social.py.

Re-run backend regression suite: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_feed_reactions.py — should stay 13/13 green.

rca_of_issue: Bug (fixed): services/social.py add_reaction() called db.feed_reactions.update_one(..., upsert=True) and unconditionally returned True inside the try block. This meant every POST returned created:true — even when the (user_id, event_id, kind) row already existed — violating the documented contract 'a second POST returns created:false and identical counts.' Fix: capture the UpdateResult and return bool(res.upserted_id). matched_count>0 & upserted_id is None on the duplicate path, so only a genuine insert now reports created:true. Counts were already correctly idempotent because the unique index prevents a second row.
